turns.text: Task: In httpx/_status_codes.py, add a classmethod is_permanent_redirect(cls, value: int) -> bool on codes that returns True for 301 and 308 and False otherwise. Add unit tests for codes.is_permanent_redirect in tests/test_status_codes.py covering 301, 308, 302, 307, and 200. Constraints: use only your file read and file edit tools, and the single shell command: py -3.11 -m pytest --noconftest -o filterwarnings=default -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_status_codes.py -q (run it at the end). Do not run any other shell command.
